question: Find the area of a regular hexagon whose side measures 16√2 cm
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area of Regular Hexagon** = 6 × (Area of equilateral triangle)

Area = 1.5 × √3 × **side**²

Area = 1.5 × √3 × (16√2)² = 1.5 × √3 × 512

Area = 768√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 768√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Side (a)** of regular hexagon = 16√2 cm

**Formula Used:** Area = [3√3 ÷ 2] × a²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/427369d7c6ba78448ed268b1eefba425b88bd6bee11c07af29316be324bb26c2.png] 

⇒ Area = [3√3 ÷ 2] × (16√2)²

⇒ Area = [3√3 ÷ 2] × (256 × 2)

⇒ Area = [3√3 ÷ 2] × 512

⇒ Area = 3√3 × 256

⇒ Area = 768√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 768√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Regular Hexagon

A **regular hexagon** consists of 6 **equilateral triangles**. All internal angles are 120° and the sum of interior angles is 720°.

Perimeter of Hexagon

The **perimeter** of a regular hexagon with side **a** is given by the formula P = 6a.

Inradius and Circumradius

Circumradius (R) = **a** and Inradius (r) = (√3 ÷ 2) × **a**.</p
